title: Google Sign-in
summary: Registers Google into the kernel sign-in shell. The GIS client id lives on this plugin, not kernel JSON.

blocks.title: Sign-in shell stays in the kernel
blocks.text: Session, OTP, unlock, and the HTTP routes stay kernel. This plugin owns provider credentials (settingsSchema / secrets). Disable the plugin to hide this method even if shop Preferences still list it.
Configure at Admin → Plugins → Google Sign-in. Kernel identity reads via getCachedPluginSettings / getCachedPluginSecret using plugin id tuucho-signin-google.
